quest.title: To the Sky-Road
quest.description: With two pieces of Pyrophosphorite in hand, the road to the skies is open to you at last...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

chapter.num: Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm: Act II
chapter.title: A Dream of Gazing Upon the Distant Sky

talks.objective: Follow Coco's guidance to find the Altar of Primal Flame

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that the Altar? That's gonna be hard to reach.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #We can fly just fine, but how about {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} and Bona?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Did you forget that I'm an adventurer of the Flower-Feather Clan? I have plenty of flight experience myself.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: #I can get over there, easy, even with {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} in tow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have a flying license, too.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: That'll do. I'll lead the way, so just follow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this going to be a race?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Wow, hey, you sure this is the time to get competitive? Relax! I'll lead the way, so just follow!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm... This feels like it could get super dangerous, and we can't know what might happen, so hold on tight, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

talks.objective: Follow Coco's guidance to find the Altar of Primal Flame
Head to the Altar of Primal Flame
Head to the Altar of Primal Flame

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Bona, that was super quick! We almost couldn't keep up back there!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Haha, sorry, sorry. I just couldn't help myself after seeing the Altar of Primal Flame just up ahead...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So all we gotta do is use this Altar, and we can go to the Tonatiuh, right? But even if a huge wind current were to lift us off the ground, who knows how long we'd have to fly before we get up there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, just thinking about it is getting Paimon all worried.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, if you say so. But don't stray too far from Paimon, you hear?

response.speaker: Bona
response.text: Anyway, so what we've gotta do now is put the Pyrophosphorite on the Altar, right? But, ah, we've got two on our hands, so... Let's put them both up there, just to be safe.

response.speaker: Bona
response.text: Right? I'm getting super excited too. No real adventurers would wanna miss out on a challenge like this!

talks.objective: Offer the Pyrophosphorite at the Altar of Primal Flame
